discussion.body: Act 11. Open world chapter: personal quests and the Deep key. Last call before rails. Each living main-side gets one personal board (Rook, Brann, Seris, Nym, Ash, Ysolde, Halric, Maera). Dead characters leave a letter or a closed door, not a failed act. Song-duel finale in Valley of Songs. Brass cards finale. The Deep key is assembled from a short list (temple rebound count, remnant fate, one personal quest). When the key exists, Act 12 can start. Player may keep roaming; the rail starts when they choose to use the key.
